route_note: High-speed Avant trains run from Madrid Atocha directly to Toledo in about 35 minutes, arriving at Toledo's station with a short local bus or walk up to the old town.

route_note: High-speed Avant trains from Madrid Chamartín reach Segovia-Guiomar in about 30 minutes, then a local bus connects the station to the old town.
Cercanías C-3 commuter trains run from Madrid Atocha and Sol directly to Aranjuez in about 45-50 minutes, with the palace a short walk from the station.

route_note: Cercanías C-3 trains from Madrid Atocha or Sol reach El Escorial station in about an hour, then a short local bus or uphill walk leads to the monastery.
